mineral_based_product.label: Mineral-based product
mineral_based_product.value: Clay cat litter and specialty mineral sorbents for fluids purification, animal nutrition, agriculture, turf, sports fields, and industrial and automotive uses.

thermal_processing_dependence.label: Thermal-processing dependence
thermal_processing_dependence.value: Thermal drying of mined clay for sorbent production.

energy_fuel_intensity.label: Energy / fuel intensity
energy_fuel_intensity.value: Lightweight cat litter and floor absorbents reduce truck fuel use per shipment volume.

delivery_radius_product_logistics.label: Delivery radius / product logistics
delivery_radius_product_logistics.value: Lightweight litter ships by truck to distributors and retailers, and low-density floor absorbents allow more bags per pallet and truckload.

raw_material_integration_model.label: Raw-material / integration model
raw_material_integration_model.value: Vertically integrated mining and manufacturing with controlled reserves of calcium bentonite, attapulgite, and diatomaceous shale.

notes: Delivery distances and manufacturing fuel intensity are unspecified.
